title:
Send me the file,
please.
body: Слово please не всегда спасает, если сама конструкция звучит как приказ.
prompt:
[CRITICAL INSTRUCTION - TEXT SAFE ZONES] 1080x1350 vertical Instagram carousel poster. Keep all readable text inside a 76px left/right safe zone and 76px top/bottom safe zone. Text must be horizontal, crisp, and readable.

[STYLE MODE] Fever Dream Editorial. Palette: warm-editorial-emerald-coral; background #f4eadc/#fff9ef; accent #0f9f6e, #ff6b4a, #243b6b. Do not copy a black-white-red reference literally; use this palette.

[TYPOGRAPHY] Condensed heavy poster typography, bold editorial hierarchy, high contrast, no tiny decorative labels except one short category label.

[HERO VISUAL] Large premium pseudo-3D cube object, glossy material, cinematic shadows, positioned so it does not cover headline.

[SLIDE CONTENT] Title: "Send me the file, please." Body: "Слово please не всегда спасает, если сама конструкция звучит как приказ."

[BRAND RULE] Product name is exactly Phraseman. No logo needed. No slide counters. No footer slogans.

[OUTPUT] Slide 2 of a cohesive carousel, poster-quality, suitable for Russian-speaking English learners.
